title: I Found It.
content: OK, so, I have found Mallworld. I am not sure I like it. It is/was a fascinating place. I have found a book store, a caffeteria, a "meditation" room, a plethora of hall ways or corridors, like the utility corrodors under large buildings. Also some open outdoor courtyards, but no way to leave the enclosure. Thank you all for your own malls.
